title: vfx standing aura (version 1)
description: data/vfx/aura.json: the current tier's aura shape and colour shown while a fighter charges or attacks, eased in and out (docs/vfx/aura-plan.md; per-tier shapes come from data/vfx/transform.json). Presentation only: read by render/vfx/aura.gd, never by the sim. Version field: version. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore. Every key is optional because aura.gd falls back to the same default. Ticks are whole ticks (60 a second), alphas 0 to 1.

standing.description: The aura shown while charging or attacking.

hold_ticks.description: Ticks it stays up after the last charge or attack.

fill_scale.description: The fill, as a share of the transformation aura's fill.

pulse.description: The breathing pulse's size (0 is none).

min_tier.description: The lowest power tier that shows it.
